findings.description: External call ammAdapter.swap(vault->underlying) at L354 precedes the state writes clientBalances[token][balanceHolder] -= amount (L361) and totalDeposited[token] -= amount (L362). clientBalances/totalDeposited are read cross-function by principalOf, totalBalanceOf, getTotalDeposited. CEI is violated, though deposit/withdraw carry nonReentrant; risk hinges on whether the AMM adapter / Curve router or token can re-enter a view-consuming path mid-swap. Adjacent to the changed deposit path but in the unchanged withdraw branch.

External call ammAdapter.swap at L416 precedes clientBalances[token][client]=0 (L419) and totalDeposited[token]-=clientStoredBalance (L420). Same CEI-after-external-call pattern as SLITHER-001; cross-function reentrancy exposure via principalOf/totalBalanceOf/getTotalDeposited. nonReentrant guards the public entry; classify after confirming adapter re-entrancy surface.

Dangerous strict equality `totalShares == 0 || totalDeposited[token] == 0` at L400 used as a branch guard in the emergency total-withdrawal path. Strict-zero checks on share/deposit accounting can mis-trigger or mis-skip the pro-rata distribution when balances are dust-but-nonzero or zeroed by rounding; warrants manual confirmation of the surrounding division math.

Local variable totalSetAside (L536) is never explicitly initialized. In Solidity it defaults to 0, so this is likely benign accumulator init, but flagged for review since _distributeBuffer governs per-client buffer apportionment in the skim/total-withdraw path.
